QuestInfo.name: [Event] Spot the Difference with Everyone!
QuestInfo.0:
Spot the Differences in this puzzling game!
Three players team up to find the differences between the two pictures together. Score points by spotting as many as you can within the time limit. Purchase all kinds of neat rewards with the points you earn!
Invitations for the game go out at the 15 and 45-minute marks of every hour. 
#b#e[Spot the Difference Game Schedule]
04/10/2019 to 04/24/2019#k#n
